title: Memory in Behavioral Models as Motion on a Slow Invariant Manifold
summary: A single-tone large-signal operating point of a nonlinear two-port is a periodic orbit of a periodically forced circuit. When the device has memory, the Floquet exponents of that orbit separate into fast (electrical) and slow (thermal and trapping) modes, and long-term memory is motion on the invariant manifold attached to the slow modes. Existence and uniqueness of that manifold follow from the parameterization method of Cabré, Fontich and de la Llave, applied to the stroboscopic map at the orbit; the manifold is the spectral submanifold of Haller and Ponsioen, without a small-forcing…
